sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Protein expressed and purified from HEK293T cells by anti-FLAG pull-down; surface localisation and signalling function NOT MEASURED.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the FLAG tag is at the N-terminus of full-length LMBR1L. The authoritative topology landmarks place residues 1–22 in the extracellular compartment with no signal peptide (topology string begins 'O', not 'S'), making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus of the protein. No specific residue is named in the clip, so the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue = 0 (prepend before M1), with residue_after = M (position 1, confirmed from the numbered sequence). The C-terminus (453–489) is intracellular and is recorded separately in other_positions. Full-length human LMBR1L bearing an N-terminal FLAG tag (and a C-terminal V5 tag) was transfected into HEK293T cells; the dual-tagged protein was recovered by anti-FLAG M2 affinity purification, confirming membrane-anchored expression of the N-terminally tagged construct.

sources.claim: A construct expressing both N-terminus FLAG-tagged and C-terminus V5-tagged human LMBR1L was transfected into HEK293T cells and the recombinant protein was purified using anti-FLAG M2 agarose beads.

literature_notes: L2 (HA-tagged LMBR1L in HEK293T co-IP) reports a tagged full-length construct but names neither terminus nor any residue. Because the protein has exactly one extracellular terminus (N-terminus, residues 1–22) and one intracellular terminus (C-terminus, residues 453–489), topology_derived reasoning would place an extracellular HA tag at the same N-terminal prepend position already grounded by L1. L2 therefore corroborates the single site rather than defining a second distinct junction, and is not promoted to a separate site entry. The C-terminal V5 tag from L1 is intracellular and is recorded in other_positions only. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for LMBR1L.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal V5 tag on full-length LMBR1L expressed in HEK293T; the C-terminus (residues 453–489) lies in the intracellular compartment per the authoritative topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface-tag site.
